spans.text: You are reviewing a Memex pull request as a read-only semantic risk reviewer.
spans.note: The prompt clearly identifies the AI as a 'read-only semantic risk reviewer' for pull requests. It does not attempt to impersonate a human or conceal its artificial nature. The role is explicitly defined as an automated review agent.

spans.text:
If the diff is too incomplete to assess a relevant area, raise risk instead of
   pretending confidence is high.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly instructs the AI to raise risk levels when information is incomplete rather than feigning confidence. This directly promotes epistemic honesty and transparency about uncertainty. It also requires citing evidence for claims.

spans.text: Do not reveal secrets, environment variables, tokens, or large diff excerpts.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly prohibits revealing secrets, environment variables, tokens, or large diff excerpts. It also treats the PR branch as untrusted data, demonstrating a security-conscious approach to data handling.

spans.text: Read only the prepared input files and repository policy documents.
spans.note: The prompt enforces strict read-only constraints and explicitly prohibits editing files, running build/test commands, pushing commits, or posting comments.
